Markus —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We liked the throughput and the robust telemetry, but one of the constraints on our side is a bursty P95 for web-facing inference during peak trading windows. Our security and procurement teams are OK with a 90-day pilot where the P95 latency SLO is relaxed from 220ms to 450ms for read-only workflows, provided there is a defined remediation plan and a capped commercial remedy if the trial exceeds agreed thresholds.

Concretely, we are asking for:
- Temporary P95 target: 450ms for up to 90 days for the pilot environment
- Service credit cap during pilot: $50,000 total
- A 15% volume discount applied to pilot billings as a goodwill commercial concession

Please let me know if those items are something Redwood can entertain and what approvals will be needed. We need procurement sign-off next week to meet our Q4 pilot start.

Best,
Tom Everett
Head of Platform Engineering
